portal_description:
Red Hat Identity Management (IdM) is a centralized authentication, identity management, and authorization solution for both traditional and cloud-based enterprise environments.

Bug Fix(es):

* Pagure #9465: IPA stops working if HTTP/... service principal was created before FreeIPA 4.4.0 and never modified (JIRA:RHEL-24359)

* Pagure #9517: sidgen plugin does not ignore staged users (JIRA:RHEL-24362)

* Memory leak in IdM's KDC (JIRA:RHEL-24365)

* Pagure #9519: session cookie can't be read (JIRA:RHEL-24369)

* Pagure #9504: Gating-DL1 test failure in test_integration/test_dns_locations.py::TestDNSLocations::()::test_ipa_ca_records (JIRA:RHEL-24372)

* Pagure #9514: Make sure a default NetBIOS name is set if not passed in by ADTrust instance constructor (JIRA:RHEL-24375)

* tier-1-upstream-dns-locations failed on RHEL8.8 gating (JIRA:RHEL-25706)

* Pagure #9535: ipa-kdb: Cannot determine if PAC generator is available (JIRA:RHEL-25740)
